package app

// TestE2E_WireNames (#55): the gen_wire golden's page declares `electionId: Text = "" as
// "ElectionId"` and `contestId: Maybe Int as "ContestId"`. Served through Serve, a request
// with ?ElectionId=17&ContestId=5 reaches the page as electionId "17"; the lowercase key is not
// read; the page's link renders ElectionId=18; its message URL carries _p.ElectionId, and the
// message's redirect renders the wire keys. TestAlderWire runs the app's own Alder test (a
// Test.get and a Test.click) as `alder test` does. internal/gen's TestGen_Wire writes this file
// into the module the app is emitted to and runs it.

import (
	"html"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	rtesting "alder/rt/testing"
)

func TestE2E_WireNames(t *testing.T) {
	h, err := Serve(Caps{}, Options{DB: ":memory:", Dev: true, Secret: []byte("test-secret-0123456789")})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := httptest.NewServer(h)
	defer srv.Close()
	c := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second,
		CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
	do := func(method, path string) (*http.Response, string) {
		t.Helper()
		req, _ := http.NewRequest(method, srv.URL+path, nil)
		res, err := c.Do(req)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer res.Body.Close()
		b, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
		return res, string(b)
	}

	res, body := do("GET", "/r/c/wood/Results?ElectionId=17&ContestId=5")
	if res.StatusCode != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, `<p id="election">17</p>`) {
		t.Fatalf("GET ?ElectionId=17: %d\n%s", res.StatusCode, body)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(body, `href="/r/c/wood/Results?ElectionId=18&amp;ContestId=5"`) {
		t.Errorf("the link does not carry the wire keys:\n%s", body)
	}
	m := regexp.MustCompile(`/_m/Wood/Bump[^"']*`).FindString(body)
	if m == "" {
		t.Fatalf("no message URL for Bump:\n%s", body)
	}
	m = html.UnescapeString(m)
	if !strings.Contains(m, "_p.ElectionId=17") || !strings.Contains(m, "_p.ContestId=5") || strings.Contains(m, "electionId") {
		t.Errorf("message URL %q does not carry the wire keys", m)
	}
	res, body = do("POST", m)
	if loc := res.Header.Get("Location"); res.StatusCode != 303 || loc != "/r/c/wood/Results?ElectionId=17&ContestId=9" {
		t.Errorf("POST %s: %d Location %q\n%s", m, res.StatusCode, loc, body)
	}

	// the field's own name is not its key: the default applies
	if res, body := do("GET", "/r/c/wood/Results?electionId=17"); res.StatusCode != 200 || !strings.Contains(body, `<p id="election"></p>`) {
		t.Errorf("GET ?electionId=17: %d\n%s", res.StatusCode, body)
	}
	// a wire key that does not decode is the page's 404, as for any parameter
	if res, _ := do("GET", "/r/c/wood/Results?ContestId=x"); res.StatusCode != 404 {
		t.Errorf("GET ?ContestId=x: %d, want 404", res.StatusCode)
	}
}

func TestAlderWire(t *testing.T) {
	rs := rtesting.Run(Tests, rtesting.Options{Tables: Tables, Caps: Caps{}.Registry(), Session: TestSession(), Routes: Routes, Web: Web()})
	if len(rs) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d results", len(rs))
	}
	if r := rs[0]; !r.OK {
		t.Errorf("%q: %+v", r.Name, r)
	}
}
